architectures.description: One module per feature and per data source. Simple, and what most apps need.
architectures.title: Compact

architectures.description: Each feature and data module split into :api and :impl, for larger teams.
architectures.title: Modular

design_styles.description: Cool neutrals, hairline outlines, a docked tab bar. Tools, finance, admin.
design_styles.title: Utility

design_styles.description: Brand-tinted surfaces, pill buttons, heavier headlines, a floating tab bar. Feeds and chat.
design_styles.title: Social

design_styles.description: Warm paper and ink, large tight display type, underlined fields. Reading and news.
design_styles.title: Editorial

design_styles.description: Cream surfaces, extra-bold type, thick outlines and offset shadows. Games and kids.
design_styles.title: Playful

features.description: Remote images with a skeleton placeholder and a failure glyph.
features.headline: Load images from URLs
features.title: Image loading (Coil)

features.description: A database for the app's own data, separate from the network cache: an entity, a DAO returning flows, a hand-written migration and a test that replays it against a database that really was at the older version.
features.headline: Store your own data, not just a cache
features.title: App database (Room)

features.description: NetworkClient with typed helpers, bearer auth with transparent 401 refresh, classified failures, and a pluggable response-envelope unwrapper.
features.headline: Talk to a REST API
features.title: REST networking (Ktor)

features.description: A Feed tab on Paging 3: pages load as you scroll, a failed page keeps what is already loaded and offers a retry, and pull to refresh reloads from where you are. The list component lives in core/ui for your own feeds.
features.headline: An endless feed that loads as you scroll
features.title: Paged feed

features.description: Per-call-site response caching with a stale-on-failure fallback, plus a queue that replays failed mutations when connectivity returns.
features.headline: Work offline
features.title: Offline cache and request queue (Room)

features.description: One long-lived socket with exponential backoff, a jittered retry and a connection state a UI can render.
features.headline: Keep a live connection open
features.title: WebSocket

features.description: Deferrable background work with Hilt-injected workers, including the manifest fix that stops WorkManager self-initialising past the Hilt factory.
features.headline: Run work in the background
features.title: WorkManager

features.description: A fingerprint, face or screen-lock prompt when the app comes back from the background, a setting to turn it on, and the app kept out of the task switcher's thumbnail.
features.headline: Ask for a fingerprint on resume
features.title: Biometric app lock

features.description: Three screens against your auth endpoints, writing the encrypted token store — with server-side field errors mapped back onto the inputs that caused them.
features.headline: Sign in, sign up, reset password
features.title: Sign in, sign up and password reset

features.description: A Continue with Google button on the sign-in screen through Credential Manager. The ID token goes to your backend, which answers with its own tokens like any sign-in.
features.headline: Continue with Google
features.title: Sign in with Google

features.description: A Profile tab with an avatar, name and bio, saved on the device per user. With the media picker on, the avatar can be a photo.
features.headline: A profile tab with a photo
features.title: Profile screen

features.description: Composable validators, per-field touched/error state, and server-side errors mapped back onto the fields that caused them.
features.headline: Validate forms properly
features.title: Form state and validation

features.description: A Language row in settings. Uses the system's per-app language on Android 13+ so it also appears in the phone's settings, and applies it by hand on older releases.
features.headline: Let people pick the app's language
features.title: In-app language picker

features.description: The real dependency list, generated from the resolved classpath at build time and rendered by the design system. The build also fails on a licence the project has not allowed.
features.headline: Show the licences you have to show
features.title: Open source licences screen

features.description: A paged walkthrough shown once, recorded in the preference store. Skipping counts as finishing, so it never comes back on the next launch.
features.headline: A first-run walkthrough
features.title: Onboarding flow

features.description: A working list + detail feature against a live public API, with its tests. Proves every wire on first run; delete it once your own first feature exists.
features.headline: A working screen to learn from
features.title: Reference feature

features.description: A Search tab: results as you type with a debounce, recent searches kept per user, and the empty, no-results and error states already drawn.
features.headline: Search as you type
features.title: Search screen

features.description: Theme switch, analytics opt-out, sign-out with confirmation and the build version — wired to the preference store and the session.
features.headline: A settings screen
features.title: Settings screen

features.description: Web pages open in a Custom Tab coloured like the app rather than in the browser. Adds privacy and terms links to settings when settings is on.
features.headline: Open web pages without leaving the app
features.title: In-app browser

features.description: A custom scheme plus verified App Links, resolved through one function, with the onNewIntent handling that is usually missing.
features.headline: Open the app from a link
features.title: Deep linking

features.description: Photo/video/document/camera pickers on the modern APIs, a permission state that can tell 'denied' from 'denied for good', and tunable image and video compression.
features.headline: Pick and compress photos and video
features.title: Media picker, permissions and compression

features.description: A flexible update offered in the background when a newer build is live, and a rating prompt on a schedule Play will actually honour rather than silently drop.
features.headline: Offer updates and ask for ratings
features.title: Play in-app update and review prompts

features.description: Notification channels, the runtime permission check, a messaging service, and token registration that re-submits on every launch.
features.headline: Receive push notifications
features.title: Push notifications (FCM)

features.description: A Glance widget in the launcher's colours showing the app's name and a line the app keeps current. Tapping it opens the app.
features.headline: A widget on the home screen
features.title: Home-screen widget

features.description: Vendor-agnostic AnalyticsTracker and CrashReporter interfaces with no-op defaults, so instrumentation can be written before a vendor is chosen.
features.headline: Track events and crashes, vendor-free
features.title: Analytics and crash-reporting seam

features.description: A draggable badge naming the environment on every build except production, and a panel behind it holding the last 200 requests with their full bodies, timing and failure rate. Absent from a production build rather than hidden in one.
features.headline: See every request the app made
features.title: On-device inspector

features.description: Analytics, Crashlytics and Remote Config in one switch: the analytics seam sends to Firebase, every logged error becomes a Crashlytics breadcrumb, and feature flags resolve from Remote Config seeded with their declared defaults.
features.headline: Analytics, Crashlytics and Remote Config
features.title: Firebase

features.description: Typed flags declared in one file with their defaults beside them, read through an interface that resolves locally until a vendor is bound. Lets both sides of a flag be written before anybody has chosen one.
features.headline: Turn a feature on without shipping
features.title: Feature flag seam

features.description: A second installable app showing every component in both themes. Depends on the design system alone, so design work rebuilds two modules instead of the whole graph.
features.headline: A second app showing every component
features.title: Component catalog app

features.description: Inter and JetBrains Mono through the Play Services font provider — a real file per weight, which bundled variable fonts do not get on every OEM build.
features.headline: Use any Google Font
features.title: Downloadable Google Font

features.description: An AppLottie component for raw, asset and URL animations, tintable to the theme and held on its last frame when the system's animations are off, with a success animation that plays when a password-reset link is sent.
features.headline: Play Lottie animations
features.title: Lottie animations

features.description: A profile generator and a macrobenchmark that measures cold start with and without it. Typically a 20-30% cut in cold start for no code change.
features.headline: Cut cold-start time
features.title: Baseline profile and startup benchmark

features.description: Reads the Compose compiler's own report and fails on a design-system composable that restarts without being able to skip. A baseline holds what is already there, so it starts green and cannot get worse.
features.headline: Catch a component that cannot skip
features.title: Compose stability check

features.description: One merged coverage number for the whole project with a floor the build enforces, generated code excluded so the report is about code somebody wrote.
features.headline: Fail a build that drops coverage
features.title: Coverage floor (Kover)

features.description: Names every module declaring a dependency it never uses, or using one it only gets transitively — the second being the failure that surfaces months later as an unrelated module breaking. Printed on every pull request; a report rather than a gate, because two of this template's own decisions produce advice it is right to ignore.
features.headline: See which dependencies nobody uses
features.title: Dependency health report

features.description: Memory-leak detection in debug builds.
features.headline: Find memory leaks in debug builds
features.title: LeakCanary (debug only)

suggestions.note: geometric, large x-height, reads well from 11sp to 32sp
the safe choice; designed for screens, very neutral
a little more character, good for consumer apps
rounder and friendlier, slightly less good at small sizes
warm and open; strong at display sizes
geometric and clean, at its best in headlines

motion_styles.description: Crisp, a trace of overshoot. Lively without asking for attention.
motion_styles.title: Standard

motion_styles.description: Springy, with a visible overshoot. Playful; wrong for anything financial.
motion_styles.title: Bouncy

motion_styles.description: No overshoot anywhere, slightly longer. For dense, professional interfaces.
motion_styles.title: Calm

motion_styles.description: The shortest response that still reads as motion. For utilities.
motion_styles.title: Snappy

presets.description: Networking, the design system, the catalog and one reference feature.
presets.title: Lean

presets.description:
The lean set plus offline cache, images, auth, onboarding, settings with a language picker, a
profile tab and media. What most projects want on day one.
presets.title: Standard

presets.description:
Every feature the template offers, working together. The template's own proof that they coexist;
delete what you do not need.
presets.title: Everything

targets.summary: Jetpack Compose, Navigation 3, Hilt, Ktor. Compact or modular.
targets.title: Android Native
